name: graft-astra-model
summary: Makes gpt-6-astra a first-class model of the running brainstem: injects it into the live model picker and routes its requests to POST {endpoint}/responses, because Astra advertises no /chat/completions route. The grail's endpoint filter is left intact. Requires the graft-engine pack.
revert: delete astra_model_graft.py and astra_responses.py; the model entry and the call_copilot wrapper are gone on the next boot, or immediately via Grafts action=revert
